basic_details.job_title: FDDI Academic Career Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Footwear Design and Development Institute (FDDI) is engaging one Academic Career Intern at its School of Leather Goods and Accessories Design (SLGAD), Kolkata campus, for an initial six months, extendable under policy. The stipend is negotiable within the Academic Career Internship Programme (ACIP) Policy limits. Applicants need a UG or PG degree in a relevant discipline with 70% marks or 7 CGPA. Applications go by email to [email protected] on or before 29 November 2026 (Advertisement No. FDDI/HO/HR/239740/2026, dated 19.11.2026).

how_to_apply: Prepare the application in the prescribed format. The notice does not print the format or a link to it.
Attach scanned copies of the supporting documents and consolidate everything into a single PDF file.

Arrange the documents in this sequence: detailed CV; educational qualification certificates and academic transcripts from Class X onwards; relevant portfolio of work/projects, wherever applicable; other relevant supporting documents such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Caste Certificate.
Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 29 November 2026.
Write "Application for Academic Career Intern – Kolkata" in the subject line of the email.
Applications received after the closing date or found incomplete may not be considered.
Statement of Purpose (SOP) outlining academic interests and career goals.
Other relevant supporting documents, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Caste Certificate.
important_instructions: The engagement is governed by FDDI's Policy for the Academic Career Internship Programme (ACIP), as amended from time to time. Selected candidates must execute a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before joining the programme. All intellectual property and outputs generated during the internship remain the property of FDDI, as prescribed under the ACIP Policy. The internship is a structured learning engagement. It is not an employment contract and gives no right to employment with FDDI.

content_sections.heading: FDDI Academic Career Intern at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee or the stipend amount.

Stipend negotiable within the limits prescribed under the ACIP Policy

content_sections.heading: About FDDI
content_sections.text: FDDI offers academic programmes at UG and PG level, and the notice states that final-year students of these programmes at FDDI may also apply. This post sits in the School of Leather Goods and Accessories Design (SLGAD) on the Kolkata campus. The engagement falls under FDDI's Academic Career Internship Programme (ACIP).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice sets one qualification for the single post. Students currently in the final year of UG/PG programmes at FDDI are also eligible to apply. Prior work experience is not mandatory. Candidates should show sound understanding and depth of knowledge in their fields, through academic projects, publications, research work or professional assignments. Candidates with an academic background in Product Design, Industrial Design, Lifestyle Product Design or a related discipline will be preferred. The desired competencies listed in the notice are: Strong understanding of product design, ideation, development and prototyping. Knowledge of leather and allied materials and their applications in product development. Proficiency in relevant 2D/3D design, CAD, modelling and visualisation software. Familiarity with emerging technologies, including sensor integration, smart products and interactive applications. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact discipline-specific eligibility.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's (UG) or Master's (PG) degree in Design, Management or Technology disciplines relevant to FDDI's academic programmes, from a reputed institution. Minimum 70% aggregate marks or 7 CGPA in the qualifying degree.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The stipend is negotiable within the limits prescribed under the ACIP Policy. The notice prints no amount. The initial internship period is six (06) months. Any extension is governed by the applicable ACIP Policy provisions and is subject to performance, departmental requirements and approval of the competent authority. Other benefits named in the notice are access to FDDI's library, software and other academic resources, and an Academic Career Internship Completion Certificate on successful completion of the programme.

content_sections.heading: FDDI Academic Career Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: Academic Assistance: assist senior faculty in pedagogy, curriculum delivery, assignment preparation and classroom management for designated subjects. Academic Development: contribute to the development of course content, lesson plans and new curriculum under supervision. Institutional Projects: participate in and contribute to projects such as craft documentation, cluster visits, workshops and research initiatives. Professional Conduct: maintain a professional work ethic and a daily log of activities, submit a final project report, and uphold the confidentiality of all institutional information.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for FDDI Academic Career Intern
content_sections.text: Prepare the application in the prescribed format. The notice does not print the format or a link to it. Attach scanned copies of the supporting documents and consolidate everything into a single PDF file. Arrange the documents in this sequence: detailed CV; educational qualification certificates and academic transcripts from Class X onwards; relevant portfolio of work/projects, wherever applicable; other relevant supporting documents such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Caste Certificate. Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 29 November 2026. Write "Application for Academic Career Intern – Kolkata" in the subject line of the email. Applications received after the closing date or found incomplete may not be considered. Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Academic transcripts and degree certificates. Statement of Purpose (SOP) outlining academic interests and career goals. Portfolio of work/projects, if applicable. Other relevant supporting documents, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Caste Certificate.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinised by the designated Intern Selection Committee. Shortlisted candidates are invited to a two-stage selection process. Domain-specific Assessment: a presentation or practical demonstration to assess the candidate's domain knowledge and technical expertise. Personal Interview: an interaction to assess suitability, potential and alignment with FDDI's academic environment. The notice does not mention dates or a venue for these stages.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is governed by FDDI's Policy for the Academic Career Internship Programme (ACIP), as amended from time to time. Selected candidates must execute a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before joining the programme. All intellectual property and outputs generated during the internship remain the property of FDDI, as prescribed under the ACIP Policy. The internship is a structured learning engagement. It is not an employment contract and gives no right to employment with FDDI.
